Get MIDAS statistics

fetch_midas_stats.Rd

Get MIDAS statistics

Usage

fetch_midas_stats()

Value

A named list with fields: total_associations, total_genes, total_diseases, sources.

Examples

# \donttest{
fetch_midas_stats()
#> Warning: Selecting ‘env’ backend. Secrets are stored in environment variables
